scope: Extend Xroga's existing Composio-backed connected-app workflow to six source-bound steps, including mixed app reads/actions and explicit public-web evidence, with bounded semantic segmentation, current-step app suggestions, visible progress, scheduled-rule reuse, and truthful OAuth ACTIVE-state verification. This is not a claim that all Composio actions or signed-in live workflows have succeeded.

keep: Current Xroga semantic planner, Composio catalog/tool-search/skill guidance, business read/action selectors, tenant boundaries, confirmation receipts, Supabase workflow checkpoints, scheduler, and budget ledger
extend: Bounded source-bound multi-step segmentation and existing workflow runner
Exact-origin OAuth callback and ACTIVE connection verification
Current-step recommendations and ordered progress display
deprecate: The callback's optimistic 'connected' message before an ACTIVE account exists

schemaImpact.rollout: The existing JSONB steps/outcomes columns support up to six validated steps and the web outcome without a SQL change. Old two-to-four-step rows continue to load.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the API/frontend revision. Existing completed workflow rows remain readable by the prior renderer only for read/action rows; do not roll back while a newly created web-step run is active without pausing and reconciling it.

auth.description: OAuth callback success is shown only after the signed-in Xroga user has an ACTIVE Composio account for that toolkit; callbacks require an exact configured frontend origin.

tenant.description: The issued TenantContext, user-bound Composio session and owner-bound workflow queries remain authoritative.

approval.description: Every app mutation still creates the existing exact-action confirmation and resumes only from its consumed effect receipt.

credentials.description: No new secret or direct app credential is read. XROGA_COMPOSIO_CALLBACK_ORIGINS is a non-secret exact-origin allowlist.

egress.description: A multi-step workflow may use the existing public-web research path when explicitly requested; later app selectors receive its bounded evidence as untrusted data.

cost.description: Ambiguous multi-step segmentation can make one additional bounded OpenRouter call, using existing budget reservation, actual-usage settlement and at most two configured models.

billing.description: No Whop, payment, subscription or pricing path changes.

tests.scope: 14 focused workflow, owner, Composio status and callback-origin tests passed, including source omission and open-redirect negative cases.
37 planner/preflight/confirmation tests passed, including no duplicate claimed action.

architecture.reason: The existing workflow table/runner, Composio client, authority gate, model router and scheduler remain the only execution path; no second orchestration framework or unrestricted proxy was added.

rollout: Set an exact preview origin in XROGA_COMPOSIO_CALLBACK_ORIGINS, deploy only a candidate Cloud Run revision and Vercel preview, then verify signed-in simple chat, app connection ACTIVE state, read, approved write, mixed web/app workflow, resume and no-duplicate retry before any xroga.com cutover.
rollback: Keep the prior ready Cloud Run revision and Vercel deployment; restore those on failed signed-in checks. Pause/reconcile any new web-step workflows before rolling back the API.
